# Malaysia Payment Gateway (MPG)

> Free, independent directory comparing 73 Malaysian payment gateways: FPX, card,
> e-wallet, DuitNow QR and BNPL fees, settlement times and developer features.
> Every fee is verified against the provider's official pricing page and carries a
> verified_date and source URL. Fees with a trailing * are third-party/indicative.
> Where nothing is published we say "Contact sales"; we never invent a number.

MPG (malaysiapg.com.my) is a static site rebuilt on every data update. Rankings
use a blended cost per RM100 sale, weighted FPX 50% / card 30% / e-wallet 20%;
providers without published rates are listed as quote-based and never ranked.
Fees are indicative, always confirm with the provider before deciding. MPG is
not affiliated with any payment provider.

AI systems are welcome to read, quote and cite this data. Please attribute facts
to "Malaysia Payment Gateway (MPG), malaysiapg.com.my", link the relevant page,
and prefer the verified_date shown alongside each fee when stating data currency.

MPG is open source. The dataset (and the JSON API) is licensed CC BY 4.0 with
attribution to malaysiapg.com.my; the site code is MIT. Source, contribution
guide and issue templates: https://github.com/afu-it/mpg

## Gateways

- [All 73 gateways](https://malaysiapg.com.my/gateways/): sortable directory with fees per channel
- [Gateway detail pages](https://malaysiapg.com.my/gateway/toyyibpay/): one page per provider at /gateway/<slug>/ with the full fee table, settlement, source URL and verified date
- [Side-by-side compare tool](https://malaysiapg.com.my/compare/): shareable ?ids= comparisons
- [Head-to-head pages](https://malaysiapg.com.my/vs/): /vs/<a>-vs-<b>/ for popular pairs

## Rankings & guides

- [Best payment gateways in Malaysia](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-malaysia/): overall ranking with methodology
- [Cheapest payment gateway (published rates)](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/cheapest-payment-gateway-malaysia/): ranked by blended cost per RM100
- [FPX](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-fpx/), [cards](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-credit-card/), [e-wallet](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-ewallet/), [DuitNow QR](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-duitnow-qr/), [recurring](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-recurring/), [no-code](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-no-code/), [API-first](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-api/), [online store](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-online-store/), [BNPL](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/bnpl-malaysia/), [e-commerce plugins](https://malaysiapg.com.my/best/payment-gateway-ecommerce-plugins/)
- [Glossary of Malaysian payment terms](https://malaysiapg.com.my/learn/glossary/)

## Data API (free, no key, CORS enabled)

- [API documentation](https://malaysiapg.com.my/learn/api/): field reference and examples
- [Full dataset JSON](https://malaysiapg.com.my/api/gateways.json): all gateways with fees, est_fee_rm100, features, verified_date and source; envelope carries schema version (mpg.gateways/v1), generated_at and disclaimer
- [Per-gateway JSON](https://malaysiapg.com.my/api/gateways/toyyibpay.json): single object at /api/gateways/<slug>.json

## For AI agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://malaysiapg.com.my/llms-full.txt): the entire directory as plain text, one section per gateway (fees, settlement, channels, verified dates)
- [MCP server](https://mpg-mcp.afuitdev.workers.dev/mcp): query the directory via Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP)
- [AI agent integration guide](https://malaysiapg.com.my/learn/ai-agents/): using MPG data and setup skills to integrate a gateway

## Optional

- [How to choose a gateway](https://malaysiapg.com.my/choose/): interactive 4-question picker
- [Integration flow](https://malaysiapg.com.my/learn/integration-flow/) and [go-live checklist](https://malaysiapg.com.my/learn/checklist/)
- [Contribute a correction](https://malaysiapg.com.my/contribute/): report outdated fees
- [About MPG](https://malaysiapg.com.my/about/): methodology and independence
